scenes.name: ADDRESSES
lines: Twelve is two times two times three. Count its twos, threes and fives.
12 = 2 × 2 × 3。数一数，它有几个 2、几个 3、几个 5。
That count is an address: two, one, zero. Every positive whole number has exactly one.
这串计数就是一个地址：(2, 1, 0)。每个正整数都有地址，而且只有一个。
We line numbers up on one ruler. Multiplication spreads them out, one direction for every prime.
我们习惯把数排在一把尺子上；乘法却把它们摊开：每个素数一个方向。

scenes.name: SUM EQUALS PRODUCT
lines: On each prime axis, one more step multiplies the weight by p to the minus s.
在每根素数轴上，每多走一步，权重就乘上 p⁻ˢ。
Add up one axis, and you get a geometric series: one over one minus p to the minus s.
把一根轴加起来，是一个等比级数：1/(1 − p⁻ˢ)。
Take s equal to two, and the axes of two and three. Four thirds times nine eighths is exactly three halves.
Each tile has area one over n squared: one tile for each n made of twos and threes.
每块瓷砖的面积是 1/n²：每个只由 2 和 3 搭成的 n，恰好一块。
Lean checks the full version: for real part of s above one, the sum over all n equals the product over all primes.
Lean 内核检验了完整的版本：只要 Re s > 1，对全体 n 的求和就等于对全体素数的乘积。

scenes.name: NO EXCHANGE RATE
lines: Can you reach one axis by walking along another? Could a power of three equal a power of two?
能不能沿着别的轴走到这根轴？3 的某个幂会不会等于 2 的某个幂？
Three to the twelfth misses two to the nineteenth by under one and a half percent. One is odd, one even.
3¹² 与 2¹⁹ 只差不到 1.5%；可一个是奇数，一个是偶数，永远不等。
Lean checks that a whole-number mix of prime logarithms is zero only when every coefficient is zero.
Lean 内核检验了：素数对数的整系数组合等于零，只有系数全为零这一种情形。
Between primes, there is no exchange rate.
素数之间，没有汇率。

scenes.name: CLOCKS ON A DOUGHNUT
lines: Give s an imaginary part t. Each prime becomes a clock, turning at speed log p.
给 s 加上虚部 t：每个素数变成一只钟，以角速度 ln p 旋转。
Two clocks read one point on a doughnut. As time runs, the point draws a line.
两只钟的读数合起来，是环面上的一个点；时间一走，它就画出一条线。
The two speeds share no common beat, so the line never closes. It winds tighter and tighter.
两个角速度没有公共节拍，这条线就永不闭合，越缠越密。
Lean checks Kronecker's theorem. Flash a lamp at fixed steps. If no nonzero whole-number mix of the steps makes whole turns, the flashes land as close as you like to any target.
Lean 内核检验了克罗内克定理：按固定间隔闪光取样；若各步的非零整系数组合都凑不成整圈，闪光读数就能任意接近任何目标。
Both clocks at six o'clock exactly? Never. As close as you like? Yes.
两只钟同时恰好指向六点？永远不会。要多近有多近？可以。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Orthogonal is a picture. The theorem is about independence; no angle is measured here.
“正交”是一幅图像；定理说的是线性无关，这里并没有量角度。
As close as you like is not soon: the proof gives no timetable.
要多近有多近，不等于很快就近：证明没有给出要等多久。
The product needs the real part of s above one. At s equals one, the sum blows up.
乘积公式要求 Re s > 1；到了 s = 1，级数就发散了。
Further left lie the zeros, and the Riemann hypothesis. An external Lean project proves it; this book has not frozen it.
再往左是零点与黎曼猜想：外部 Lean 4 项目已经证明了它，本书所钉的仓库没有冻结它。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter twenty-two.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第二十二章
